narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The sacred writer: narration, genealogies and the words that introduce speech.

1.t: These are the generations of the sons of Noe: Sem, Cham, and Japheth: and unto them sons were born after the flood.

2.t: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Thubal, and Mosoch, and Thiras.

3.t: And the sons of Gomer: Ascenez and Riphath and Thogorma.

4.t: And the sons of Javan: Elisa and Tharsis, Cetthim and Dodanim.

5.t: By these were divided the islands of the Gentiles in their lands, every one according to his tongue and their families in their nations.

6.t: And the Sons of Cham: Chus, and Mesram, and Phuth, and Chanaan.

7.t: And the sons of Chus: Saba, and Hevila, and Sabatha, and Regma, and Sabatacha. The sons of Regma: Saba, and Dadan.

8.t: Now Chus begot Nemrod: he began to be mighty on the earth.

9.t: And he was a stout hunter before the Lord. Hence came a proverb:
Even as Nemrod the stout hunter before the Lord.
9.q: a proverb quoted by the narrator, not spoken by anyone in the scene; kept with narrator

10.t: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon, and Arach, and Achad, and Chalanne in the land of Sennaar.

11.t: Out of that land came forth Assur, and built Ninive, and the streets of the city, and Chale.

12.t: Resen also between Ninive and Chale: this is the great city.

13.t: And Mesraim begot Ludim, and Anamim and Laabim, Nephthuim.

14.t: And Phetrusim, and Chasluim; of whom came forth the Philistines, and the Capthorim.

15.t: And Chanaan begot Sidon his firstborn, the Hethite,

16.t: And the Jebusite, and the Amorrhite, and the Gergesite.

17.t: The Hevite and Aracite: the Sinite,

18.t: And the Aradian, the Samarite, and the Hamathite: and afterwards the families of the Chanaanites were spread abroad.

19.t: And the limits of Chanaan were from Sidon as one comes to Gerara even to Gaza, until thou enter Sodom and Gomorrha, and Adama, and Seboim even to Lesa.

20.t: These are the children of Cham in their kindreds and tongues, and generations, and lands, and nations.

21.t: Of Sem also the father of all the children of Heber, the elder brother of Japheth, sons were born.

22.t: The sons of Sem: Elam and Assur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.

23.t: The sons of Aram: Us, and Hull, and Gether; and Mes.

24.t: But Arphaxad begot Sale, of whom was born Heber.

25.t: And to Heber were born two sons: the name of the one was Phaleg, because in his days was the earth divided: and his brother's name Jectan.

26.t: Which Jectan begot Elmodad, and Saleph, and Asarmoth, Jare,

27.t: And Aduram, and Uzal, and Decla,

29.t: And Ophir, and Hevila, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Jectan.

30.t: And their dwelling was from Messa as we go on as far as Sephar, a mountain in the east.

31.t: These are the children of Sem according to their kindreds and tongues, and countries in their nations.

32.t: These are the families of Noe, according to their people and nations. By these were the nations divided on the earth after the flood.
